note: Adapted from the English species-level description in Bacchus (1997); the alate is recorded as Unknown in the original, so only the soldier section is taken; the measurement table is truncated in the extracted text, so no measurements are cited.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to pale orange, labrum pale yellow to yellow; mandibles brown to reddish brown with yellow bases; antennae pale yellow, segment 1 darker; postmentum the same colour as the head, concolorous with the genae; thoracic nota and abdomen yellowish white to yellow; legs pale yellow to yellow. Head capsule short-oval, sides narrowing anteriorly, distinctly broader posteriorly; head surface with very numerous setae, regularly and symmetrically arranged; labrum ligulate, with 3 pairs of setae on the anterior third, the apical pair long, the posterior pairs very short, less than half as long as the long pair. Mandible apex slightly incurved, curvature 0.03 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest, slightly shorter than segment 4, segments 1 and 2 subequal; postmentum short and broad. Pronotum saddle-shaped, narrower than the head, anterior margin with a broad shallow V-shaped notch in the middle, posterior margin almost straight. Fore tibia slightly inflated; spurs 3, the dorsal spur longer than half the outer ventral spur. A large seta on the fore coxa not spine-like.
